'''Kai toks''' were flying predators of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].

==History==
Not much was known about this [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] like creature. Until more research was done, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] recommended that [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] stay away from them, unless they were members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

[[File:HornedRaptor.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A mutated horned raptor]]
They could in fact be trained as personal companions. They were part of the [[Reptavian/Legends|Reptavian]] family, and could be mutated into [[horned raptor]]s. Unlike normal kai toks, horned raptors could not fly, and had a considerably different appearance.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KaiTokConceptArt-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Kai toks appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
